own_rural_quote: Asked (in a thread on Marico's own low-single-digit GT decline) whether GT growth in rural India was worse than last quarter, the CEO said 'No, not really... similar kind of a level... our volumes... broadly similar' - an explicit own no-change statement; the 'very bad August' remark (p.10) answers a question on the rural economy 'from the FMCG perspective' and mirrors the sector sentiment paragra

CEO explicitly separates sector from company ('rural being 2X of urban for the FMCG sector, specifically for us it's been more or less in line'), so it is own data, but it is a level (rural ~ urban) with no stated change in pace (rule 1 -> steady) and was given in reply to a Parachute-specific question, hence low.
